# EfficientDet-D1

Object Detection · `efficientdet-d1_640x640` · DX-APP Python example

Object Detection model, evaluated on COCO.

**Input** 640 × 640 × 3 · **Dataset** COCO · **License** Apache-2.0 · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

![EfficientDet-D1 output](result.webp)

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models EfficientDetD1
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/object_detection/efficientdet/efficientdet-d1_640x640/efficientdet-d1_640x640_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/efficientdet-d1_640x640.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target efficientdet-d1_640x640_sync   # once
./bin/efficientdet-d1_640x640_sync \
  -m assets/models/efficientdet-d1_640x640.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | mAP |
|---|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 38.45 |
| Q-Lite | 36.86 (−1.59) |
| Q-Pro | 28.13 (−10.32) |

COCO · difference vs Raw in brackets.

> **Note:** Q-Pro is 10.32 points below Raw on mAP.
